game_theory_router.description: Selects optimal model based on task, cost, and privacy preferences.
rules: If user prefers offline and has Ollama installed -> use local model
If task is forensics and cloud is acceptable -> use Claude 3 Haiku
If task is password/seed and budget is constrained -> use GPT-4o-mini
Default -> use Ollama llama3:8b if available, else fallback to cloud
